Further comments should be made on the article's [[{{TALKSPACE}}:{{{1|{{BASEPAGENAME}}}}}|current talk page]] rather than here so that this page is preserved as a historic record.<!-- Substituted from Template:Talkarchive --><noinclude></div>

==Usage==
<pre>
{{subst:Talkarchive|Article}}
</pre>
[[wikipedia:Wikipedia:Substitution|Substitute]] the template at the top of an archived talk page, replace <code>{{Var|Article}}</code> with the appropriate article's name, and add <code><nowiki></div></nowiki></code> to the bottom of the page.

If the article name is not given, the template will use the MediaWiki [[mw:Help:Magic words|magic word]] <code><nowiki>{{BASEPAGENAME}}</nowiki></code>.
